# youtube-coach-harness

> A Claude Code agent that analyses a YouTube channel with real API data and
> labels every figure with its provenance, so an estimate can never be
> presented as a measurement.

The defining idea: every tool returns a `source` field — `youtube_api`
(measured), `derived` (computed), `heuristic` (own rubric), `config` (local
file) or `generated` (model artefact). The operating contract in CLAUDE.md
forces the agent to respect it when citing. Tools that cannot measure something
return the open question instead of a plausible number.

Needs Python 3.10+. A `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` unlocks all public-data tools; OAuth is
only required for the channel owner's private analytics.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/README.md): what it is, what you can ask it, how it works
- [Install guide](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/docs/install.md): step by step, written for an agent to follow
- [Operating contract](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): identity, honesty rules, transparency protocol
- [Tool catalogue](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/TOOLS.md): all 28 tools, their commands and quota cost
- [Limits](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/LIMITS.md): what it cannot do and why
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): exit codes and known failure modes
- [Contributing](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the one non-negotiable rule
- [Spanish README](https://github.com/lorena-bordonaba-pau/youtube-coach-harness/blob/main/docs/README_es.md)

## Optional

- 20 data tools: analytics, retention curve, traffic, outliers, keywords, transcripts
- 4 image tools: provider-agnostic generation, editing, deterministic export, channel packaging
- 17 skills with fixed tool execution orders, including one that forbids answering about itself from memory
- Scoring rubrics that ship uncalibrated on purpose, to be built from your own channel
